attributes.name: Oriented on meaningful outcomes
attributes.description: Each capability exists to deliver an outcome for the public, the environment or the department.

attributes.name: Stable over time
attributes.description: Capabilities change far more slowly than organisations, processes or systems.

attributes.name: Independent of organisation structure
attributes.description: A capability can be delivered by core Defra, an arm's length body or a partner.

attributes.name: Independent of technology
attributes.description: Capabilities say what we do, never which product does it.

attributes.name: Measurable
attributes.description: We can assess maturity, cost, risk and investment against each capability.

attributes.name: Expressed in active, plain language
attributes.description: Verb first, no jargon, understandable by anyone.

business_capabilities.name: Act as a custodian of the environment and ecosystems
business_capabilities.description: Understand, protect, restore and enhance the natural environment - land, water, air, seas, habitats and species - for current and future generations.
outcomes: Clean air and clean and plentiful water
level2: Protect and recover species and habitats
Manage land, water, air and marine resources
Manage flood and coastal erosion risk
Manage natural capital and biodiversity net gain

business_capabilities.name: Conduct research and analyse evidence
business_capabilities.description: Build and use the scientific, economic and social evidence base that underpins policy, regulation and operational decisions.

business_capabilities.name: Create policy and legislation
business_capabilities.description: Develop, consult on, implement and evaluate policy, legislation and regulation, including international and trade agreements.
outcomes: Policy informed by those it affects

business_capabilities.name: Engage with citizens and organisations
business_capabilities.description: Inform, advise, listen to and build relationships with the public, farmers, businesses, partners and other stakeholders.
outcomes: Users can find what they need and do what they need to do
Strong relationships with the sectors we work with
level2: Handle enquiries, complaints and information requests

business_capabilities.name: Issue licences and permits
business_capabilities.description: Decide whether and on what terms people and organisations can carry out regulated activities, and keep registers of what has been permitted.
outcomes: Regulated activity happens safely and lawfully

business_capabilities.name: Enforce compliance
business_capabilities.description: Check that people and organisations meet their obligations and take proportionate action when they do not.
outcomes: Harm prevented, and stopped quickly when it happens

business_capabilities.name: Administer funds and grants
business_capabilities.description: Design and run schemes that pay public money for public goods, from application to payment, verification and recovery.
outcomes: Public money delivers environmental and economic outcomes
Payments are accurate, on time and protected from fraud

business_capabilities.name: Respond to incidents and crises
business_capabilities.description: Prepare for, detect, respond to and recover from emergencies such as animal and plant disease outbreaks, floods, droughts and pollution.
outcomes: Reduced harm to people, animals, plants and the environment

business_capabilities.name: Operate and deploy assets
business_capabilities.description: Plan, build, operate, maintain and dispose of physical assets such as flood defences, laboratories, vessels, land and estate.
outcomes: Assets are available and perform when needed

business_capabilities.name: Set organisational direction
business_capabilities.description: Set strategy and priorities, allocate investment, manage performance and risk, and govern the department and its arm's length bodies.

business_capabilities.name: Provide shared services
business_capabilities.description: Provide the people, finance, commercial, digital, data and technology, estates, legal and information services the rest of Defra relies on.
outcomes: Staff have the tools and support to do their jobs
level2: Provide digital, data and technology services

technology_domains.name: Engage and transact
technology_domains.description: How users find us, prove who they are, tell us things and pay us.

technology_domains.name: Operate and decide
technology_domains.description: How we process work, make decisions and keep records.

technology_domains.name: Data and insight
technology_domains.description: How we collect, manage, share and learn from data and evidence.

technology_domains.name: Platform and integration
technology_domains.description: The foundations every service is built and run on.

technology_capabilities.name: Customer identity and access
technology_capabilities.description: Let citizens, businesses and their agents sign in, prove who they are and act on behalf of an organisation.

options.name: Defra Customer Identity (Defra ID), which uses GOV.UK One Login and Government Gateway as identity providers

technology_capabilities.name: Staff identity and access
technology_capabilities.description: Single sign-on, role-based access and joiner/mover/leaver for Defra group staff and contractors.

technology_capabilities.name: Digital forms and applications
technology_capabilities.description: Capture structured information from users through accessible, GOV.UK design system compliant forms without bespoke front-end builds.

technology_capabilities.name: Notifications
technology_capabilities.description: Send emails, text messages and letters to users.

technology_capabilities.name: Payments and collections
technology_capabilities.description: Take card and other payments for fees, charges and penalties.

technology_capabilities.name: Content and publishing
technology_capabilities.description: Publish guidance, policy, consultations and news.

technology_capabilities.name: Customer and stakeholder relationship management
technology_capabilities.description: A single view of the customers, organisations and stakeholders we deal with, and our interactions with them.

technology_capabilities.name: Case and workflow management
technology_capabilities.description: Route, track and complete work items (applications, inspections, investigations, claims) through configurable workflow.

options.name: Workflow on the Core Delivery Platform for high-volume digital services

technology_capabilities.name: Rules and decisioning
technology_capabilities.description: Express eligibility, risk scoring and business rules as versioned, testable artefacts rather than burying them in code.

options.name: Rules as code libraries within the service (default)

technology_capabilities.name: Document and records management
technology_capabilities.description: Store, classify, retain and dispose of documents and records in line with the Public Records Act and retention schedules.

options.name: Cloud object storage for service-generated documents

technology_capabilities.name: Field work and inspection
technology_capabilities.description: Plan, schedule and record inspections, surveys and sampling in the field, including offline mobile working and evidence capture.

technology_capabilities.name: Incident and emergency management
technology_capabilities.description: Detect, log, coordinate and report on incidents such as animal and plant disease outbreaks, floods and pollution events.

technology_capabilities.name: Finance and enterprise resource planning
technology_capabilities.description: General ledger, purchase to pay, order to cash, HR and payroll.

technology_capabilities.name: Grants and scheme management
technology_capabilities.description: Configure schemes, take applications, manage agreements, verify claims and make and recover payments.

options.name: Reusable grants components on the Core Delivery Platform

technology_capabilities.name: Geospatial and location services
technology_capabilities.description: Store, analyse, visualise and serve spatial data - land parcels, boundaries, designations, catchments and observations.

options.name: Defra Interactive Map, an accessible mapping component (beta)
Ordnance Survey data via the Public Sector Geospatial Agreement

technology_capabilities.name: Data platform and analytics
technology_capabilities.description: Ingest, store, transform and analyse data at scale with governed access for analysts and data scientists.

technology_capabilities.name: Reference and master data
technology_capabilities.description: Authoritative, shared records for the things many services depend on: customers, organisations, holdings, land parcels, species, locations.

options.name: Authoritative source per entity - see Defra on a page

technology_capabilities.name: Environmental monitoring and IoT
technology_capabilities.description: Ingest and manage high-volume telemetry and observations from sensors, gauges, samples and earth observation.

technology_capabilities.name: Data sharing and publishing
technology_capabilities.description: Share data with partners through APIs and publish open data with good metadata.

technology_capabilities.name: Artificial intelligence and machine learning
technology_capabilities.description: Train, evaluate, deploy and monitor models, including generative AI, safely and transparently.

options.name: Approved cloud AI services within Defra cloud tenancies

technology_capabilities.name: Application hosting and delivery platform
technology_capabilities.description: Build, test, deploy and run services on a secure, observable, paved road with the undifferentiated heavy lifting done once.

technology_capabilities.name: API management and integration
technology_capabilities.description: Publish, secure, discover and manage APIs and asynchronous messaging between services and with partners.

options.name: Platform API gateway and messaging on the Core Delivery Platform

technology_capabilities.name: Observability and security monitoring
technology_capabilities.description: Logs, metrics, traces, alerting and protective monitoring feeding the security operations centre.

options.name: Platform observability on the Core Delivery Platform

technology_capabilities.name: Collaboration and productivity
technology_capabilities.description: Email, documents, meetings and team collaboration for staff.
